resources.string: Without a backup, losing this phone means losing your Secured chats.
A backup lets you bring your Secured profile, contacts and text messages back on a new phone, using 12 words.
If you lose the 12 words, the backup is gone for good. Nobody, including us, can recover it.
Anyone who has the 12 words can restore your Secured profile. Treat them like a house key.
Use these words only in Encrogram. Never type them into a website or send them to anyone.
The backup is encrypted on this phone before it is uploaded to our server. It holds your profile, contacts and text messages, not photos or files. Messages after the last backup are not in it.
Write them down on paper, in this order. This screen blocks screenshots on purpose; don\'t photograph it or save the words in a notes app.
Type the words you wrote down for these three positions.
These don\'t match the words on the previous screen. Check what you wrote down, or go back to see the words again.
Encrogram refreshes the backup after a new contact connects, and about once a day when something changed. You can check it, back up again or turn it off under Backup in the Secured menu.
Type the 12 words of your backup, in order, separated by spaces. This restores your Secured profile, contacts and text messages as of the last backup.
\"%1$s\" is not in the word list. Check the spelling.
Restoring doesn\'t switch off your old phone. If it was lost or stolen, start a new Secured profile instead of restoring.
Secured is still starting. Try again in a moment.
This phone already has a Secured profile. A backup can only be restored on a phone with no Secured profile.
Secured can\'t start right now, so nothing can be restored.
Your profile, contacts and text messages are back as of %1$s. Anything sent after that is not in the backup.
Each chat now has to re-sync its encryption with your contact, which happens when they are online. Until then, messages in that chat can be delayed or lost.
Your contacts show as not verified again once they re-sync. Compare security codes again.

Restoring does not switch off the old phone. Both phones hold the same keys until each chat has moved to new addresses; until then messages go to whichever phone connected last. If the old phone was lost or stolen, start a new Secured profile instead.
Without a backup, losing this phone means losing your Secured profile, contacts and messages.
No backup has been uploaded yet.
Encrogram refreshes the backup after a new contact connects, and about once a day when something changed. Messages after the last backup are not in it. Photos and files are not included yet.
Use your screen lock to show the 12 words.
To show the 12 words, this phone needs a screen lock (PIN, pattern, password or fingerprint). Set one in Android settings, then try again.
The unlock expired or wasn\'t accepted. Try again.
This deletes the backup from our server and the 12 words from this phone. Your chats on this phone stay as they are. If you turn backup on again later, you get new words.
These 12 words aren\'t valid. Check each word and the order; the last word works as a check, so one wrong word is usually caught.
No backup was found for these words. Check them, or the backup may never have been made or may have been deleted.
Unlock your phone with its screen lock first. If this phone has no screen lock, set one in Android settings.
Couldn\'t reach the backup server. Check your connection and try again.
